study: Wrist angles from a shared movement encoder
domain: Offline cued, constrained right-wrist pointing on the WristMotion v3 stored 512-Hz grid. Source wrist distance from HoloAssist and rat camera distances remain distinct centimetre end points. Strictly reuse the existing frozen common temporal encoder. No coordinate conversion, shared-person identification, neural actuation, force, language decoding or clinical inference.
cohort: Six previously used TRAIN people only in original order sub-37, sub-03, sub-15, sub-17, sub-38, sub-43. Six outer folds each hold one whole person. Never read previously assessed three, reserved six or other people. The exposed sub-41 example is outside every fold and pilot. The six people and their earlier outcomes informed study motivation. This is an exploratory extension on reused records, with dependence across outer folds. No population inference, multiplicity-adjusted significance or independent confirmation.
samples: 11274 complete joint rows, 1879 trials, 47 participant-runs. Six target slots at cue+384,512,640,768,896,1024 ticks. The encoder anchor is target-128 ticks. Sixteen consecutive nonoverlapping 16-tick bins ending at the anchor cover half a stored second. Two mean angles minus anchor in degrees, four RMS bipolar forearm EMGs in stored uV and eight mean scalp EEGs in stored uV. Preserve exact source row, parent and target-tick identity. Absolute two-axis target in degrees (extension, radial deviation). A 250 ms interval is on the stored clock; actual hardware delay unknown. Prior whole-trial complete support, including retrospective outcome availability, retained; not prospective stream coverage.
modes: Separately fit motion; motion plus EMG; motion plus EMG plus EEG. For each bin, normalize two motion, four EMG and eight EEG features using fitting people only. Mask unavailable modalities to exactly zero after standardization. Split 16 bins into four chronological consecutive groups of four, flatten the 4 x 14 features in original time order. Append standardized two-axis anchor and six one-hot cue slots at each token. Each wrist projection receives 64 scalars. No trial direction, participant ID, absolute time or outcome enters the model. A selected mode accepts only its required channels as a prefix of width 2,6,14. Missing or nonfinite required inputs abstain; an absent modality routes through an explicitly selected lower-dimensional model.
architecture: Separate learned 64->24 input projection and 24->2 angular residual readout for each mode. Reuse the exact frozen pretrained four-position embedding, 4-head width-24 temporal attention, FF width 48, residuals, layer norms and final norm. All three routes refer to one copy of that state; spatial input projection and output rows remain byte-for-byte identical. Regression predicts normalized target minus anchor; invert residual normalization then add the supplied anchor. Independent copies of the identical width/depth/heads/fixed positions and norms initialized from the original untrained SharedMotion with torch.manual_seed(104927) are the matched frozen-random controls, including random Q/K/V, output and FF matrices. Only the adapters train in either condition. Reference for angular checkpoint source: SHA256 9a3649cb8f2119984e7f9f0b96a07bdc95e1833c7068f0e9caef2680f22e3179 (legacy spatial checkpoint).
training: Fixed seed 20261120, identical projection initialization, zero-initialized output, fixed row shuffle with NumPy default_rng(20261120), identical sequence per fitted arm per fold. 4 full epochs; batch 128 in source row order before shuffling; deterministic CPU float32 PyTorch, AdamW lr .001, betas .9/.999, eps 1e-8, decay .01, clip gradient norm 1. Mean squared error across normalized residual axes and rows. Population (ddof 0) mean/std of each bin channel over all fitting rows and times, and of each anchor and residual axis over fitting rows; replace degenerate std <=1e-8 with 1. Same normalization, fit people/rows/opportunities and hyperparameters for pretrained/random and all three modes. Fixed one published all-six refit per pretrained modality with same method; no fold/seed/epoch/arm selection and no random final refit. Fit gradients for adapter only. Fit or score comparisons reopen no legacy large fits. Keep fold state and out-of-fold predictions private. No fit-derived changes after scores.
comparators: Persistence; exact prior cross-fitted motion CNN and previously fitted CNN with EMG correction in muscle-correction after verifying source acceptance and matching person/block/trial/slot, recording/cue/target tick, persistence anchor and observed target by key. No use of these forecasts in adapter fitting. Donor control in each outer person's evaluation is the next eligible distinct trial in its block and slot, wrapping at end. Substitute only the four aligned forearm channels in the EMG model or only eight scalp channels in the full model, retaining anchor, history, cue and all other inputs. Apply to both pretrained and matched random models. Donor includes a subsequent or wrapped trial only as a deliberately impossible offline intervention. Never infer trial specificity independently of motion/contact artifacts.
metrics: Average squared angular errors by person and axis, then equal-weight six people and two axes before square root in degrees. Report per-axis RMSEs, paired participant-equal differences and ranges after omission of each of six persons plus number improving. Primary comparison pretrained full minus pretrained motion. Secondary EMG minus motion, full minus EMG, aligned minus swapped for both, pretrained minus matched random in each modality, versus persistence and earlier CNN and CNN+EMG correction. Report mean and RMS same-adapter change in predicted angle under swaps separately from change in error. No score threshold, hypothesis test, tuning, fallback selection or claim of transfer superiority. All-six checkpoint is the registered pretrained model irrespective of scores.
execution: Choose lower median synthetic deterministic first 32 matched fit update wall time on CPU 1 versus 2 threads ABBA, one interop/BLAS thread. Full fit and scoring instrumented separately. CUDA/HIP availability, framework-controlled kernels, hardware pressure and reproducibility checked. No global resource changes.
